theorems.name: Finite safe homothety-lattice observer
theorems.assumptions: Finite control, nonsingular integer X6 actions, fixed prime and positive integer threshold; future choice depends only on retained control
theorems.statement: Embedded normalized column lattices preserve all future linear carry observations. Before threshold m, p^(m-1)Z_p^6 <= H <= Z_p^6, hence finitely many states.

theorems.name: Exact unbounded-time threshold reachability
theorems.assumptions: PK-001 plus fixed positive rational stochastic rows
theorems.statement: The threshold compiler preserves actual first hitting. Removing boundary-inaccessible closed classes makes the residual kernel transient; existing BRC star gives exact rational hitting probability.

theorems.name: Sound frontier intervals
theorems.assumptions: All transitions of retained states checked; unknown safe targets routed to an explicit frontier
theorems.statement: HIT and FRONTIER probabilities h,u certify [h,h+u]; nested expansions tighten bounds and a complete safe ball has u=0.

theorems.name: Killed split-heartbeat exact peak law
theorems.assumptions: U/V complementary triple-axis scalings; probabilities s/2,s/2, stop 1-s

theorems.name: Noncommuting action/peak-observer equivalence
theorems.assumptions: Specified A/B involutions modulo scalar, three-block X6 lift and integer-unimodular conjugacy; equal probabilities
theorems.statement: Reduced word length equals carry spread. Its stopped random evolution shares PK-004 peak law, not its full affine-effect process.

theorems.name: Fixed-threshold/global-bound separation
theorems.assumptions: Same stochastic model over all thresholds
theorems.statement: Each fixed threshold has finite-state exact reachability; this does not decide existence of an all-threshold uniform bound. Decreasing tails converge to the probability of an infinite peak.
